description:
You are a biomedical engineer preparing a pre-operative implant sizing report for a cranial reconstruction case. The CT Cranium DICOM series is already loaded in InVesalius 3. A patient intake brief is available at /home/ga/Documents/patient_brief.txt.

Your task is to prepare a complete implant sizing package:
1. Create a bone segmentation mask using Hounsfield thresholds appropriate for bone tissue (bone is typically above 226 HU)
2. Generate a 3D bone surface mesh from the mask
3. Place at least 5 linear cranial measurements: maximum transverse diameter (widest left-right span), maximum anteroposterior diameter (longest front-to-back span), skull height (vertex to foramen magnum base), and at least 2 additional anatomically relevant dimensions such as temporal width or orbital width
4. Export the 3D bone surface as a binary STL file to /home/ga/Documents/implant_sizing.stl
5. Save the complete InVesalius project (with mask, surface, and all measurements) to /home/ga/Documents/implant_plan.inv3

Login credentials: username=ga, password=password123
